import re, os, sys
roots = ["drivers/net", "drivers/staging", "drivers/usb", "drivers/scsi", "drivers/tty", "net"]
sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)

def find_softirq_callbacks(root):
    tasklet_cbs = []   # (file, cbname, lineno)
    napi_cbs = []
    for dirpath, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
        for fn in files:
            if not fn.endswith(('.c',)):
                continue
            p = os.path.join(dirpath, fn)
            try:
                txt = open(p, errors='ignore').read()
            except Exception:
                continue
            # tasklet init with explicit callback
            for m in re.finditer(r'tasklet_init\s*\(\s*([^,]+)\s*,\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*,', txt):
                cb = m.group(2)
                line = txt[:m.start()].count('\n')+1
                tasklet_cbs.append((p, cb, line, 'tasklet_init'))
            # tasklet_setup(&t, cb)
            for m in re.finditer(r'tasklet_setup\s*\(\s*[^,]+,\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*\)', txt):
                cb = m.group(1)
                line = txt[:m.start()].count('\n')+1
                tasklet_cbs.append((p, cb, line, 'tasklet_setup'))
            # DECLARE_TASKLET / DECLARE_TASKLET_OLD

                line = txt[:m.start()].count('\n')+1

            # NAPI poll registration

    return tasklet_cbs, napi_cbs

all_tasklet, all_napi = [], []
for r in roots:
    t, n = find_softirq_callbacks(r)
    all_tasklet += t

print("tasklet callbacks:", len(all_tasklet))
print("napi polls:", len(all_napi))
